run_save_rust_format: run the script to extract fixed-length queries from a HuggingFace dataset and save them in Rust-compatible binary format
run_find_whitespace: run the find_whitespace function to yield indices of all whitespace characters in a text string
create_binary_queries: create a binary file with length-prefixed UTF-8 query snippets extracted from dataset text at whitespace boundaries
refactor_find_whitespace: refactor the find_whitespace generator to filter specific whitespace characters like tabs or newlines
review_save_rust_format: review the script that loads a HuggingFace dataset and writes query snippets to a binary file with 4-byte little-endian length prefixes
